answer: A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The copper counter is kept in karst and falcon shows each reset. An copycat as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 21 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
